name: Maine Woodworks
old_description: We build custom-made furniture in Maine—thoughtful, well-made pieces designed to fit your home and your life.
about:
Maine Woodworks, based in Saco, Maine, was founded in 1991. The company builds custom-made furniture, emphasizing thoughtful design and craftsmanship.

The company produces a range of residential furniture including bedroom, dining, entryway, office, and occasional pieces. Each item is handcrafted in Maine using regionally sourced sustainable hardwood and traditional joinery such as four-corner English dovetails. Finishes are eco-friendly and inspired by the natural colors of Maine. Production is made-to-order, allowing customers to customize panel styles, leg designs, hardware, and finishes. The workshop also offers assembly services and white-glove delivery scheduling.

Maine Woodworks serves primarily residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces for their homes. It also operates a Trade & Hospitality program catering to interior designers, contractors, and hospitality clients such as hotels and inns. The company’s furniture has been specified for commercial projects, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The business was started to create well-made, customizable furniture that fits the way people live. The company highlights its combination of elevated design and exceptional craftsmanship, with a focus on durability—building pieces intended to last for generations. Its differentiators include Maine-based handcrafting, sustainable materials, dovetail joinery, and a made-to-order model with a typical lead time of six to eight weeks.
